resources.string: Keep Lumio working in the background

Shows a persistent notification. Keeps the Bluetooth session and in-app timers running while the app is minimized. Turn on Auto reconnect above. May stop after force-stop, reboot or aggressive battery optimization.
Export devices, colors, scenes, and schedules to a JSON file. The backup includes Bluetooth addresses: share it only with people you trust. Import replaces local settings.
Cannot read or write this file
Uses the controller’s internal effect, which may be smoother and continue without the phone. Mode support depends on the firmware. Select a static color to exit.
Connect an RGB light to start a timer.
Background mode is on. The notification service will try to keep the timer and BLE session alive while minimized; Android may still stop it.
Background service is on. Weekly schedules work when Bluetooth stays connected. After reboot, open Lumio again.
Allow notifications to keep the background service visible.
